  395 |     function isDarkMode() {
-----
  439 |         var fill;
  440 |         var stroke;
  441 |         var view;
  442 |         if (danger) {
  443 |             color = dark ? "#FFFFB0B0" : "#FFB42323";
  444 |             fill = dark ? "#2AD75D66" : "#14D92D36";
  445 |             stroke = dark ? "#4FD75D66" : "#30D92D36";

  447 |             color = dark ? "#FFE5F1FC" : "#FF285777";

  449 |             stroke = dark ? "#556F9FC7" : "#40799DBB";

 1046 |     function bytesToHex(bytes) {
 1047 |         var out = "";
 1048 |         var i;
 1049 |         var v;
 1050 |         for (i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
 1051 |             v = Number(bytes[i]);
 1052 |             if (v < 0) { v += 256; }
 1053 |             out += (v < 16 ? "0" : "") + v.toString(16);
 1054 |         }
 1055 |         return out;
 1056 |     }

 1293 |     function translationHex(bytes) {
 1294 |         var output = [];

 1296 |         var number;
 1297 |         var text;

 1301 |             text = number.toString(16);
 1302 |             output.push(text.length === 1 ? "0" + text : text);
 1303 |         }
 1304 |         return output.join("");

 1506 |     function translateConfiguredSync(text, providerOverride) {
 1507 |         var config = translationSettings();
 1508 |         var provider = providerOverride ? String(providerOverride) : config.engine;
 1509 |         text = String(text === null || text === undefined ? "" : text);
 1510 |         if (text.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "").length === 0) {
 1511 |             throw new Error("翻译内容不能为空");
 1512 |         }
 1513 |         if (text.length > config.maxChars) {
 1514 |             throw new Error("翻译内容超过 " + config.maxChars + " 字符");
 1515 |         }
 1516 |         return provider === "youdao" ?
 1517 |             translateYoudao(text, config) : translateBaidu(text, config);
 1518 |     }

 1520 |     function postTranslationCallback(callback, result) {
 1521 |         if (typeof callback !== "function") { return; }
 1522 |         runOnMain(function () { callback(result); }, 0);
 1523 |     }

 1525 |     function translateConfiguredAsync(text, callback, providerOverride) {
 1526 |         var generation = translationGeneration + 1;
 1527 |         var worker;
 1528 |         translationGeneration = generation;
 1529 |         translationState.requestCount += 1;
 1530 |         worker = new JavaThread(new Packages.java.lang.Runnable({
 1531 |             run: function () {
 1532 |                 var result;
 1533 |                 try {
 1534 |                     result = translateConfiguredSync(text, providerOverride);
 1535 |                     translationState.successCount += 1;
 1536 |                 } catch (error) {
 1537 |                     translationState.errorCount += 1;
 1538 |                     result = { ok: false, error: String(error),
 1539 |                         sourceText: String(text || "") };
 1540 |                 }
 1541 |                 postTranslationCallback(callback, result);
 1542 |             }
 1543 |         }), "ClipHub-Translation-" + String(generation));
 1544 |         worker.setDaemon(true);
 1545 |         worker.start();
 1546 |         return generation;
 1547 |     }

 1592 |                 "翻译失败";

 1617 |         return true;
 1618 |     }

  407 |     function bytesToHex(bytes) {
  408 |         var out = "";
  409 |         var i;
  410 |         var v;
  411 |         for (i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 1) {
  412 |             v = Number(bytes[i]);
  413 |             if (v < 0) { v += 256; }
  414 |             out += (v < 16 ? "0" : "") + v.toString(16);
  415 |         }
  416 |         return out;
  417 |     }
  418 |

  420 |         var packedBytes = Base64.decode(text, Base64.DEFAULT);

  143 |     function hexSha256(bytes) {
  144 |         var digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes);
  145 |         var out = [];
  146 |         var index;
  147 |         var value;
  148 |         var hex;
  149 |         for (index = 0; index < digest.length; index += 1) {
  150 |             value = Number(digest[index]);
  151 |             if (value < 0) { value += 256; }
  152 |             hex = value.toString(16);
  153 |             out.push(hex.length === 1 ? "0" + hex : hex);
  154 |         }
  155 |         return out.join("");
  156 |     }
